summary: Phase 1 of the implementation plan: first burn-temperature results (0-D D-T plasma at reactor scale stays ≥ 10 keV for all t ≥ 0 under supplied Bosch–Hale data and state-dependent τ_E hypotheses, with fuel dilution), the parabolic comparison principle for radial heat transport, and the vacuum maximum principle with boundary-to-interior field-error bounds. Idealized models; no coil-produced stellarator, no barrier on a stellarator geometry yet, no all-mode stability.

tasks.model-contracts:I1: Partially implemented — algebraic force balance and tangency; positive permeability and actual differential laws in the restricted slab model.
tasks.model-contracts:I2: Lean verified — uniform-field and nonzero-current force-free witnesses in the Cartesian slab model; not toroidal confinement.
tasks.model-contracts:I3: Partially implemented — common-witness contracts and an assumption ledger; full decoded candidate identity remains pending.
tasks.model-contracts:I4: Partially implemented — interval containment, continuous clearance, and exact whole-box slab margin; text parsing and general signed multiplication remain pending.
tasks.model-contracts:I5: Partially implemented — conditional conservation and coercivity bounds for continuous symmetric forms on one normed space; no MHD PDE bridge.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G1: Lean verified — field/current tangency and uniform-field witness; the analytic instance is Cartesian, not toroidal.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G4: Partially implemented — Lipschitz-cover clearance at every parameter point; Fourier bounds, regularity, and embedding certificates remain pending.
tasks.plasma-models-and-equilibrium:E1: Lean verified — tangency; force-free slab; exact toroidal (Solov'ev) and helical finite-pressure equilibria satisfy the kernel ForceBalance law with actual Ampère current.
tasks.mhd-stability:S1: Partially implemented — abstract energy conservation and norm bounds conditional on a differentiable solution; same-space variant only.
tasks.mhd-stability:S3: Partially implemented — scalar two-channel Young drive inequality; integral MHD identity and geometric coercivity remain pending.
tasks.mhd-stability:S4: Partially implemented — exact neutral-drift counterexample; the MHD quotient and admissible-space characterization remain pending.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K3: Partially implemented — finite-time drift; all-time full-orbit trapping by IVT; symmetry-defect finite-time confinement with first-exit bootstrap (ripple example). 3.5 MeV alphas and guiding-centre averaging remain open.
tasks.verified-numerics:N1: Partially implemented — exact mantissa/scale decoding, interval containment, addition, negation, and nonnegative products; no text parser yet.
tasks.verified-numerics:N2: Partially implemented — continuous Lipschitz-cover clearance; Fourier and tail estimates remain pending.
tasks.verified-numerics:N3: Partially implemented — exact two-block checker plus a polynomial interval checker (kernel decide) proving Riccati/Jacobi certificates; matrix factorization pending.
tasks.verified-numerics:N4: Lean verified — local contraction existence/uniqueness, radii inequalities, and the injective equation bridge; operator-specific bounds are hypotheses.
tasks.verified-numerics:N5: Lean verified — nonlinear scalar x²=2 validation on [1,2], with residual 1/12 and Lipschitz constant 1/3; not a plasma PDE.
tasks.verified-numerics:N9: Partially implemented — common-witness composition and restriction of uncertainty sets; candidate decoding and physical feedback closure remain pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D1: Partially implemented — filament integral, bounds, actual Fréchet derivative, and source-free Maxwell identities (∇·B=0 for any filament, ∇×B=0 for closed filaments) away from the source; higher derivatives pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D2: Lean verified — exact circular-loop vector field on its axis and orientation reversal; the two-loop fixture has a positive midpoint field for positive equal currents.
tasks.coils-and-design:D3: Partially implemented — arbitrary 3-D placed circles preserve C¹ regularity, closure and simplicity; tube envelopes have continuous clearance/disjointness and manufacturing-margin transfer. Embedded winding packs and self-clearance remain pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D5: Partially implemented — full-parameter position/tangent errors imply a C⁰ filament-field error; independent current errors compose with the same actual coils. Rigid-pose errors supply C¹ curve budgets; Cᵏ field-error bounds for k≥1 remain pending.
tasks.vacuum-demonstrator:VD1: Partially implemented — primary CNT design/error-field sources reviewed and arbitrary 3-D circle poses formalized; a complete versioned four-coil placement/current dataset has not been frozen.
tasks.vacuum-demonstrator:VD2: Partially implemented — fixture fields with derivatives, error budgets and now proved source-free Maxwell identities for closed filaments; not yet a four-coil stellarator.
tasks.vacuum-demonstrator:VD4: Partially implemented — residence bound for the probe; all-time field-line and particle confinement proved in analytic symmetric equilibria, but not for a coil-produced field.
tasks.materials-and-engineering:M2: Partially implemented — slab existence, uniqueness, maximum, whole-box bound and exact 998/45 K synthetic margin; coolant-flow identity remains pending.
tasks.roadmap:P0: honest kernel: Partially implemented — limited MHD/thermal law bundles, analytic witnesses, counterexamples, and a dated assumption ledger; no full 3-D domain model.
tasks.roadmap:P1: useful exact building blocks: Partially implemented — energy, intervals, contraction, clearance, filament field and slab thermal results; remaining field/engineering targets are explicit.
tasks.roadmap:P2: continuous vacuum candidate: Partially implemented — two-loop fixture with derivatives, error budgets, clearance and proved Maxwell identities; finite-conductor and nonaxisymmetric coil confinement certificates remain pending.
tasks.roadmap:1: Partially implemented — tangency and genuine slab witnesses; full toroidal MHDEquilibrium interface remains pending.
tasks.roadmap:2: Partially implemented — conditional energy theorem, coercivity and neutral drift; V-to-H embedding and MHD bridge remain pending.
tasks.roadmap:3: Partially implemented — rational interval core and acceptance/rejection proofs; no general text parser.
tasks.roadmap:4: Partially implemented — continuous Lipschitz-cover clearance; Fourier derivative bounds remain pending.
tasks.roadmap:5: Lean verified — slab laws, unique solution, whole-box maximum and exact synthetic temperature margin; no material qualification claim.
tasks.roadmap:6: Partially implemented — current linearity, loop formula, actual field-integral differentiation, perturbation bounds and source-free Maxwell identities.
tasks.roadmap:7: Lean verified — scalar block checker and polynomial interval checker with Riccati/Jacobi stability certificates; no MHD tail estimate.
tasks.roadmap:8: Partially implemented — common-witness contracts; decoded geometry identity, source data and complete candidate ledger remain pending.
tasks.plasma-models-and-equilibrium:E3: Partially implemented — an exact Solov'ev solution is verified directly against J×B=∇p (Δ*ψ=3R² checked by hand only); general Grad–Shafranov equivalence pending. A helical (JFKO-type) exact equilibrium is also verified.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G2: Partially implemented — divergence/curl operators with sanity lemmas; Clebsch fields ∇ψ×∇χ are divergence-free for C² potentials; reciprocal-basis identities pending.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G9: Partially implemented — exact first-integral barriers confine field lines for all time in analytic Clebsch-torus, Solov'ev and helical fields; no KAM/a posteriori torus for a perturbed or coil-produced field yet.
tasks.mhd-stability:S6: Partially implemented — sharp Hardy inequality, Suydam sufficiency (coercive margin) and necessity (explicit unstable modes near resonance) for the localized form; screw-pinch Suydam criterion with a realistic certified profile. δW reduction is sourced, not formalized; Mercier pending.
tasks.mhd-stability:S7: Partially implemented — Newcomb/Picone certificates with an exact polynomial checker; the screw-pinch example is Newcomb-δW-stable for all 1 ≤ |m| ≤ 6 and all n (wall at edge), not yet uniformly in m; no 3-D all-mode certificate.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K1: Lean verified — Newton–Lorentz energy and speed conservation, exact uniform-field gyration, Larmor-radius formula and realistic exact bounds.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K2: Partially implemented — Noether conservation of canonical momentum for any Killing symmetry (rotation, translation, helix) for full orbits; reduced Hamiltonian theory pending.
tasks.roadmap:P3: confined reduced orbits: Partially implemented — all-time full-orbit confinement in exact Solov'ev and helically symmetric equilibria (rigidity-limited; 3.5 MeV alphas not covered); finite-time bound under symmetry defects. Not for a coil-produced stellarator.
tasks.roadmap:P4: finite-pressure equilibrium: Partially implemented — exact smooth Solov'ev (toroidal, axisymmetric) and helical (straight, nonaxisymmetric) equilibria satisfy the kernel law at realistic 5 T / few-percent β; no coil or free-boundary matching.
tasks.roadmap:P5: all-mode MHD result: Partially implemented — Suydam both directions; screw-pinch Newcomb δW ≥ 0 for all modes with 1 ≤ |m| ≤ 6 (reduction supplied, wall at edge); no all-mode result for a 3-D equilibrium.
tasks.implementation-plan:M0: Lean verified — exact slab, screw-pinch, Solov'ev and helical equilibria with kernel force balance, all-time field-line/orbit confinement, Suydam both ways and screw-pinch Newcomb for 1 ≤ |m| ≤ 6 (idealized symmetric models).
tasks.implementation-plan:M1: Lean verified — 0-D D-T burn at n = 1e20 m⁻³, V = 830 m³, carbon Z_eff = 1.7: T ≥ 10 keV for all t ≥ 0 (P_aux ≥ 40 MW, τ_E ≥ 3.5 s at T ≤ 10 keV; margin +5.5 MW); window [10,30] keV only with supplied τ_E degradation; reactivity is supplied data.
tasks.implementation-plan:M2: Partially implemented — comparison principle (strict, margin, non-strict; lower/upper/two-sided barriers) for the radial heat equation is proved for supplied classical solutions; no barrier instantiated on the Solov'ev/helical geometry yet.
